findings.title: Editing, backfilling or un-deleting an older balance reading makes that reading's Coinbase collateral the current one. The live CB LTV, the crash-day gate and the plan's run all read that figure, because deriveCbCollateral picks the latest reading by ts and every edit or Undo bumps ts.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P1: addDayEvent A {date 2026-03-05, ts 1000, reading {strikeBal 10000, strikeLtv .10, strikeCollateral 1, cbBal 4000, cbLtv .40, cbCollateral 1}}; addDayEvent B {date 2026-03-25, ts 2000, ... cbCollateral 2}. Output: 'P1 before edit: {..."cbCollateralBtc":2,"anchor":12000,"anchorAsOf":"2026-03-25"}'. Then the owner fixes a typo: updateDayEvent(A with strikeBal 10500, CB fields re-saved as stored — EventSheet.tsx:161-166 seeds them, :413-417 writes them back). Output: 'P1 after edit : {..."cbCollateralBtc":1,"anchor":12000,"anchorAsOf":"2026-03-25","planCbCollateral":1}'. P12 (same events, cbLoanBalance 80000, trigger 75): 'P12: {"before":{"cbCollateralBtc":2,"crashDay":false},"after":{"cbCollateralBtc":1,"crashDay":true},"trigger":75}'. Path: dayLogSlice.ts:40 sets ts=Date.now(), then :48 refreshCbCollateralCache (dailyRouting.ts:24-27) calls logUtils.ts:277 `e.ts >= best.ts`, which selects A. Other triggers with the same effect: undoDayEventDeletion (dayLogSlice.ts:81, fresh ts); a past-dated add with its reading filled (cbCollateral is required with a loan, eventSheetModel.ts:157), including the Review's 'Add balance reading' for a past month (DailyModeView.tsx:555-559). Readers: planRun.ts:48-49 planCbCollateralOf (the plan's run), DailyModeView.tsx:144-147 → crashPlaybookView.ts:66-72 isCrashDay, payloads.ts:112 (trusted viewer snapshot), and setDayLog (dayLogSlice.ts:100) re-derives it on every device that pulls the edit.
findings.whyItMatters: A typo fix in a weeks-old reading halves or doubles the Coinbase collateral behind the Safety gauge, the Emergency Console's gate and the plan's to-do list. With $80,000 owed at $100,000/BTC the LTV jumps from 40% to 80%, and Daily and THIS MONTH flip to 'Crash day — work from the Emergency Console'. In the other direction it hides a real margin call. The wrong figure syncs to every device and to the trusted viewer.
findings.fixSketch: Order deriveCbCollateral by (date, ts) as deriveStrikeCollateral and deriveReadingAnchors do (logUtils.ts:302, :443). The existing tests use a single date (dailyMode.test.ts:281), so they stay green.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9. file-structure.md:2097-2098 records 'a past reading's typed CB collateral becomes the current one' only as a residual of the past-dated add. The edit and Undo triggers need no new figure from the owner and are recorded nowhere. daily-mode.md:106 even claims an edited reading 'becomes the date-latest reading'; P1 refutes that.

findings.title: A Strike balance re-anchored while no Strike collateral is recorded writes strikeLtv = Infinity into the month entry. JSON turns it into null, and the restore validator then rejects the whole backup as malformed.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P4: reset advisorStartDate=todayLocalISO(), hasCbLoan false, strikeCollateralBtc 0; emitBalanceReading({ strikeBal: 5000 }) (the call SafetyDashboard.tsx:148 saveStrike and SimpleModeView.tsx:114 Quick Setup make). Output: 'P4 entry strikeLtv: Infinity' — dayLogSlice.ts:118 computeStrikeLtv → ltv.ts:21 (+∞ for debt with 0 collateral) → logUtils.ts:171 copies it into the entry. JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(buildPlanBackup(state))), the same serialisation exportPlan.ts:52 uses → 'P4 backup entry strikeLtv after JSON: null' → validatePlanBackup → 'P4 validate: {"code":"bad-records","message":"This backup contains a malformed month entry."}'. validatePlanBackup.ts:74-76 requires typeof number on strikeLtv. localStorage persists the same JSON, so after a reload the in-memory entry is already null, and every later backup fails too.
findings.whyItMatters: The backup file is the owner's recovery path. One month logged in this state makes the app refuse the whole file: every month, every day event and every setting. The error blames the file, and the owner finds out only on the day they need to restore.
findings.fixSketch: Never store a non-finite LTV in a reading or month entry: leave it absent, or represent ∞ explicitly, at emitBalanceReading and rollupMonth. Have the validator accept a null strikeLtv/cbLtv instead of dropping the backup.
findings.notKnownBecause: §9 has no backup-format item. A4-4 (another auditor) reports only the display after a reload ('0.0% LTV'), not the restore refusal.

findings.title: Correcting a just-logged Strike deposit, or tapping Undo after deleting it, counts the deposit twice in Strike collateral. The sheet's own readout says ₿1.12; the store then holds ₿1.22.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P5: today-dated reading {strikeCollateral 1, ts 1000}, then the sheet's LD6 pair: deposit 0.1 target strike ts 2000 + reading {strikeCollateral 1.1, ts 2000}. getCurrentBtcHeld = 1.1. updateDayEvent(deposit amount 0.12) → 'P5: {"before":1.1,"after":1.2200000000000002}'. EventSheet.tsx:329-332 shows the pre-save readout as currentBtcHeld − origEffect + amount = 1.1 − 0.1 + 0.12 = 1.12. Path: dayLogSlice.ts:40 sets ts=Date.now(); logUtils.ts:308-309 then counts a same-date move with e.ts > anchor.ts on top of the reading, which already states the post-move total. P7: the same pair, deleteDayEvent('dep') → 1.1 (the reading still states it), then undoDayEventDeletion(ev) (dayLogSlice.ts:81, fresh ts) → 'P7: {"before":1.1,"afterDelete":1.1,"afterUndo":1.2000000000000002}'.
findings.whyItMatters: Strike collateral is overstated by the deposit's amount. The Strike LTV and liquidation on Safety, Daily's 'Avail credit' (DailyModeView.tsx:136) and the plan's run all read it, so the owner sees more room to draw than Strike gives. Both triggers are the commonest corrections: fixing an amount right after saving, and undoing an accidental swipe-delete.
findings.fixSketch: Keep an edited or restored strike move out of its anchor's window: separate the merge version clock from the occurrence order, or re-emit the paired reading on edit. Undo should restore the exact prior state.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9. engines.md:518 and logUtils.ts:372 say, under the cold ledger, 'Residual (same as strike): updateDayEvent bumps ts, so editing a same-day pre-anchor move makes it count'. That is one line, not queued, and silent on Undo (P7), whose whole job is to restore the prior state.

findings.title: A month's recorded closing balances come from its latest reading by ts, not by date. Editing or backfilling an earlier reading in the month therefore replaces the month-end Strike balance, the LTVs and the Coinbase balance in the Ledger, its CSV, THIS MONTH's past-month view and the next month's carry-forward.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P1 (the events of A2-1): before the edit m3 = {strikeBal 12000, strikeLtv .12, cbLtv .20}; after editing the Mar 5 reading m3 = {strikeBal 10500, strikeLtv .10, cbLtv .40}, while the live anchor stays 12000 @ 2026-03-25. P2: m3 has a Mar 25 reading (12000) and is confirmed; backfilling a Mar 5 buy plus its typed reading (10000, ts 3000) gives 'P2: {"m3":{"strikeBal":10000,"confirmed":false},"m4":{"strikeBal":10000,"provisional":true},...}'. The m4 figure comes from a reading-less Apr 10 draw, because priorStocksForMonth (logUtils.ts:225-229) also sorts by ts. Readers: LedgerFace.tsx:172/227, ledgerCsv.ts:140, planMonthView.ts:454-456 (its doc comment: 'A logged month's end'), logUtils.ts:36 deriveCurrentPosition (the Advisor's position). Every other reading reader orders by (date, ts): deriveStrikeCollateral logUtils.ts:302, deriveReadingAnchors :443, unreconciledCbFlows :346.
findings.whyItMatters: The month-end Strike balance and the LTVs beside it are wrong money figures in the record the owner signs and exports. They disagree with the Safety gauge, which reads the same readings by date, and re-signing the reopened month attests the wrong figure.
findings.fixSketch: Select the month's stock reading by (date, ts) in rollupMonth and priorStocksForMonth. dailyMode.test.ts:205 uses a single date, so it stays green.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9. daily-mode.md:18-19 states the by-ts rule from P1, written before backfill (P4c-2) and the ts-bumping edit (P3) existed. daily-mode.md:105-107 accepts the ts bump only for 'same-day ts ordering' and claims the edited reading 'becomes the date-latest reading'; the probe refutes both.

findings.title: Changing the 'Strategy start date' in Settings re-buckets the journal but leaves the month log on the old months. The next event then double-counts in the Ledger, and signed months keep figures their review no longer shows.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P6: start 2026-01-01; Jan 20 draw 1000 + reading; Feb 10 draw 2000 + reading; confirmMonth(1), confirmMonth(2). setAdvisorStartDate('2026-01-15') (the SettingsMain.tsx:791-797 date input; AdvisorSidebar.tsx:95) → 'P6 after date change: {"start":"2026-01-15","log":[{"m":1,"exp":1000,"confirmed":true},{"m":2,"exp":2000,"confirmed":true}],"review1Drawn":3000,"review2Drawn":0,"bucketFeb10":1}'. Adding a Feb 12 buy + reading (now month 1) → 'P6 after one more month-1 event: {"log":[{"m":1,"exp":3000,"confirmed":false},{"m":2,"exp":2000,"confirmed":true}],"ledgerTotalExpenses":5000,"drawnInJournal":3000}'. Path: advisorJournalSlice.ts:44 only calls emitPlanSets. rerollMonth (dailyRouting.ts:111) runs only from a day-event mutator, for that event's month. reconcileMonthBuckets is one-shot: the flag is set at :139, and useMonthBucketReconcile.ts:26 returns once it is done.
findings.whyItMatters: The Ledger and its CSV show $5,000 of expenses for $3,000 drawn. Month 2 stays signed with $2,000 that its review now shows as $0. THIS MONTH's expenses prompt averages expensesActual (logUtils.ts:63), and its Update writes that average into the plan.
findings.fixSketch: On a start-date change, re-roll all twelve months (the reconcile without its one-shot flag), or refuse the change once the journal holds events.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9. The docs describe the one-shot reconcile only for the bucketing fix (journal.md § Strategy-Month Calendar Fix) and say nothing about a later start-date edit.

findings.title: A signed month's 'Expenses actually paid' adjustment is overwritten by the ledger's draws on any later re-roll (a reading added, a buy logged). The re-review seeds from the draws again, so the adjustment is lost unless the owner retypes it.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P3: Mar 10 draw 3000 + reading; confirmMonth(3, {expensesActual: 3500, strikeMinSource:'roll'}) → 'P3 signed: {"expensesActual":3500,"confirmed":true}'. Adding a Mar 31 reading → 'P3 after a reading: {"expensesActual":3000,"confirmed":false}'. Path: addDayEvent → rerollMonth → dailyRouting.ts:153 `{ ...base, ...rollupEntry }`, where rollupEntry.expensesActual is the sum of Strike draws (logUtils.ts:136). ReviewSheet.tsx:60 re-seeds toCents(rollup.streams.draw) under the hint 'adjust if you covered expenses from savings' (:128). The 5d comment at dailyRouting.ts:128-131 names this overwrite, but only for the dollars-only path.
findings.whyItMatters: The adjustment the review invites (bills paid from savings) disappears without a word; the banner says only 'confirm your log'. expensesActual feeds THIS MONTH's expenses prompt (computeExpenseReanchor, logUtils.ts:57-70), whose Update writes the plan's expenses.
findings.fixSketch: Keep the signed expensesActual apart from the rollup's draws (an override the re-roll leaves alone), or seed the re-review from the previously signed figure with the draws shown beside it.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9. journal.md's two characterised defects are the stale Coinbase prefill and a re-roll that never clears a field. This is the opposite: a re-roll that overwrites a figure the owner entered.

findings.title: The past-date note promises 'this month is marked provisional until a reading is logged'. With no reading in the prior month, the month is instead written with a $0 Strike balance and 0.0% LTV and is not marked provisional. The review then says 'Confirm these figures are correct' and offers no 'Add balance reading'.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P9: start 2026-01-01; addDayEvent Jan 10 draw 1000 with the reading skipped (what EventSheet.tsx:440-442 writes for a past add) → 'P9 m1: {"strikeBal":0,"strikeLtv":0,"confirmed":false}' (no provisional key). A reading-less Feb 10 draw → 'P9 m2: {"strikeBal":0,"strikeLtv":0}'. Path: logUtils.ts:181 carries stocks forward only `if (hasFlow && priorStocks)`, and dailyRouting.ts:141-151 seeds strikeBal 0 / strikeLtv 0. Consequences: DailyModeView.tsx:129 isProvisional is false, so the banner reads 'Month 1 — confirm your log' (:306); ReviewSheet.tsx:171-173 shows 'Confirm these figures are correct…' with Confirm only (:186-189); LedgerFace.tsx:161/172/179 prints '0' and a green 0.0% in a row that isn't italic; planMonthView.ts:456 prints 'Strike $0.00 · 0.0% LTV'. P10: the delete confirm at EventSheet.tsx:828 says 'If a today flow loses its reading, the month is marked provisional', but deleting month 1's only reading left {"strikeBal":5000,"strikeLtv":0.05,"cbBal":4000,"btcHeld":1,"provisional":false}.
findings.whyItMatters: Two sentences on the sheet are false for the first month and for any month after a reading-less one. The month's balances read as recorded fact ($0 owed, 0% LTV, green) when nothing was read, and the owner signs them.
findings.fixSketch: Mark a month with flows and no reading as provisional even without prior stocks, leaving its stocks absent rather than 0. Otherwise, make both sentences conditional on a prior-month reading.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9: its 'zero-state words' are the faces' zero states. journal.md's stale-field defect covers flows a re-roll keeps, not the provisional promise or the $0 seed.

findings.title: Strike's minimum shows MISSED for the first part of every strategy month that starts after the due day. The chip compares today's calendar day with the due day but counts payments by strategy month, so a bill paid on time lands in the previous month.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P11 uses the inputs that DailyModeView.tsx:160-166, PlanMonthCard.tsx:157-160 and EventSheet.tsx:478-485 pass. Start 2026-01-20; today 2026-02-25, in strategy month 2 (Feb 20 – Mar 19), whose bill is due Mar 15. The Feb 15 minimum was logged on time; bucketEventToMonth puts it in month 1. Output: 'P11: {"month":2,"paidSoFar":0,"status":"MISSED","feb15Month":1,"mar15Month":2}'. The cause is simpleModePlan.ts:98 `isCurrent && todayDay > dueDay → 'MISSED'`. It also errs the other way: on 2026-01-25 a Jan 15 payment made before the start is clamped into month 1 and reads PAID for the Feb 15 bill (first probe run).
findings.whyItMatters: Every month, from the start day to the end of the calendar month, the Daily plan card, THIS MONTH's foot and the paydown sheet tell an owner who paid on time that they missed Strike's minimum, weeks before the next bill is due.
findings.fixSketch: Decide DUE / MISSED against the due date that falls inside the strategy month (a date, not a day-of-month), and count payments from the previous due date.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9: 'Strike's minimum, two estimates' is about the amount. No doc mentions the mismatch between calendar months and strategy months.

findings.title: The Ledger's footnote '† includes a non-draw / minimum payment.' is false. The dagger sits on the Paydown cell, which never includes Strike's minimum or the NDP, and the minimum's amount appears nowhere in the Ledger or its CSV.
findings.evidence: cd /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 && /tmp/hardening-1/bin/slot npx vitest run src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --silent=false --reporter=verbose (probe deleted after; real store via useStore.setState reset: advisorStartDate 2026-01-01, hasCbLoan true, btcPrice 100000, isAuthenticated false, planEvents []). P8: rollupMonth([minPayment 150 on 2026-03-15, reading]) → 'P8 rollup: {"strikeMinPaid":150,"strikeMinSource":"income","strikeBal":12000,"strikeLtv":0.12,"provisional":false}'. There is no paydown key: logUtils.ts:149-156 makes the minimum balance-neutral and never adds it to paydown. LedgerFace.tsx:153 sets rowNote = ndpPaid != null || strikeMinPaid != null; :166-167 prints fmtUsd0(e.paydown) = '0' with '†'; :247 reads '† includes a non-draw / minimum payment.' ReviewSheet.tsx:79 writes strikeMinPaid on every income-mode sign-off, so every such month carries the dagger. ledgerCsv.ts:127-131 has no strikeMinPaid or ndpPaid column.
findings.whyItMatters: A '0†' paydown reads as '$0, including a minimum payment'. The owner can't see what was paid, and the CSV drops the minimum and the NDP entirely.
findings.fixSketch: Reword the footnote (e.g. '† Strike's minimum / NDP paid this month — not in Paydown') and show the amount in the table and the CSV.
findings.notKnownBecause: Not in §9. Sweep 1's sixteen screen and word items aren't in the repo at the base, so I couldn't rule them out; the judge should check this one against that list.

examined: flowVenue's 'strike' default holds at every dayLog reader (rollupMonth logUtils.ts:135/145, isMonthlyMeaningful dailyRouting.ts:74, aggregateEvents calendarModel.ts:150/154, rebuildEditedFlow eventSheetModel.ts:73, describeDayEvent dailyView.ts:45/56, unreconciledCbFlows logUtils.ts:352). Coinbase flows stay out of expensesActual and paydown, and out of the review's 'Expenses actually paid' seed. Sound.

A buy's dollars are kept. rebuildEditedBuy keeps the typed usd (eventSheetModel.ts:143-146). updateDayEvent decides dollarsOnly before the write and skips refreshBalanceAnchors (dayLogSlice.ts:44-55). rerollMonth's dollarsOnly path writes only income (dailyRouting.ts:132-135). monthEntryCurrent's lag check holds, and no engine reads entry.income (grep). Sound.

One ledger, one sign-off: confirmMonth and unconfirmMonth go through upsertLogEntry and its M2 guard (advisorJournalSlice.ts:57-115), and every dayLog mutator and monthly write refuses before the plan loads (5c). Sound.

The reading anchor: deriveReadingAnchors picks the date-latest reading, applies the asOf guard, and falls back on delete with the date+value proxy. P1 showed that editing an older reading leaves advisorActualBlocBalance at 12000 @ 2026-03-25. Sound.

deriveStrikeCollateral orders by (date, ts) with a strict tie, so a backfilled strike move before the anchor isn't re-summed, and a past add omits strikeCollateral (readingCollateralPolicy). Sound apart from A2-3.

The strategy-month clock: strategyMonthIndex clamps 29/30/31 starts, and bucketEventToMonth, strategyMonthDate and monthDateRange agree. Journal date math works on yyyy-mm-dd strings in UTC space (calendarModel.ts:32, dailyRouting.ts:20 are the only toISOString uses), and 'today' is todayLocalISO everywhere in the journal (DailyModeView.tsx:176/191, EventSheet.tsx:90/249, runAdvisor.ts:11-13). Sound.

The Review's 'Add balance reading' targets the reviewed month (readingTargetDate). The reconcile hook never runs in viewer mode or before the plan loads. The FAB, EventSheet and ReviewSheet are gated on !viewerMode. Sound.
The Ledger CSV: RFC-4180 escaping, CRLF, sorted by month, an unrecorded btcHeld exported as an empty cell, cold totals row-scoped with the footnote. Sound.

Seen but not reported, because documented or known: a re-roll never clears a field the month no longer has (journal.md defect 2; P10 shows the stocks behave the same way); month 12 keeps every later event (logUtils.ts:48-49); '+$X stacked' prices the BTC at today's price by design (phase-4.md:285); an income-mode sign-off of a past month also clears blocStatementMinimum (DailyModeView.tsx:542, the same line as §9's 'a re-signed old month moves the NDP date'); a pledged buy's edit splitting from its deposit (§9).
Probe src/__probe__/A2-probe.test.ts (12 cases, P1–P12) was written in /tmp/hardening-1/audit-A2 and then deleted. git status --porcelain is empty in that worktree and in /home/user/Personal-BLOC.
